text:
Ana: quick thread — we need the final headline + chart set for the benchmark launch. primary audience is engineers & platform buyers. focus is the latency vs cost story for common prompt lengths. any strong opinions?

Liam: my vote: avoid tokens-per-dollar jargon up front. lead with a clear SLA framing — e.g. '99th-p50 latency tradeoff at X cost' then show tokens-econ as a secondary axis. :thinking_face:

Sophia: agree on 2-tier narrative: 1) real-time apps (latency-sensitive) 2) batch/analytics (cost-sensitive). each gets its own shareable chart + one combined scatter for the blog.

Max: for visuals, propose a scatter (x=median latency, y=cost per 1M tokens), color by model family, marker size = throughput. overlay iso-cost contours so readers can see pareto lines. short caption: 'Choose your tradeoff: faster at higher cost, or cheaper at larger latency.'

Liam: sample chart config (for data viz team):
```
x: median_latency_ms
y: cost_per_1M_tokens_usd
color: model_family
size: tokens_per_second
annotations: p50, p99, iso_cost_contours
```

Ana: CTA options — which to A/B test in launch? 1) 'Estimate your cost with your prompt' 2) 'Run a 1-click latency test' 3) 'Book an engineer demo'

Sophia: route CTAs: 1+2 -> self-serve product funnel; 3 -> enterprise AE. For webinar signups, send top 20% latency-sensitive leads to AE queue. add hidden field for expected monthly tokens to score.

Max: For copy, try tight microcopy: 'See how your app performs — paste a prompt, get latency & cost estimates in <60s.' short, concrete.

Jordan-bot: created a quick summary doc + tracking ticket: https://confluence.redwood.ai/benchmarks/launch-plan (placeholder). I also added UTM params for the two CTAs and a lead-routing rule to the marketing automation queue.

Liam: design ask -> @Liam can you mock three chart variants: 1) split two-panel, 2) combined scatter with contours, 3) small-multiples by workload. low-fi is fine. deadline EOD Friday?

Ana: EOD Friday works. Sophia will pick the default headline after seeing mocks. thanks everyone — we'll reconvene Thu morning to pick final CTAs + webinar hook. :rocket:
